name: triplet
title: Triplet distance
description: Number of leaf triples resolved differently by the two trees. Finer-grained than Robinson-Foulds, which judges a whole clade present or absent; a triple disagreement is a smaller unit than a clade, so this does not saturate on large clades the way RF does. Computed by TreeDiff (Branco, Vaz & Francisco 2024), run as a separate process.

references.citation: Critchlow, D.E.; Pearl, D.K.; Qian, C. The Triples Distance for Rooted Bifurcating Phylogenetic Trees. Systematic Biology 1996, 45, 323–334.
Branco, A.P.; Vaz, C.; Francisco, A.P. Computing RF Tree Distance over Succinct Representations. Algorithms 2024, 17, 15.

summary.label: Triplet distance
summary.description: Leaf triples on which the two trees disagree, out of C(n,3) possible.
